safety_assault_protection_002.evidence: F: Work Related Assault Leave / Any member of the bargaining unit, acting in the course of his/her assigned duties, who sustains an injury of a duty-related assault, shall be eligible to “paid assault leave”... The court appearance of any employee so assaulted or called as a witness in connection with the prosecution of a work-related assault shall be without loss of pay or use of PTO days. / E: Reimbursement Funds / The District will maintain a fund to cover loss of employee’s personal property due to physical assaults... filed within one (1) week of the incident with the Risk Management Department
